profile.org_note: Single-market private builder with no divisions: the four 'areas' on its website are sales groupings, not divisions with presidents. It is the homebuilding arm of Tim Fleet's Lackland Holdings, LLC, which buys and develops land and sells lots to Riverside and to other builders from the same office (3045 Lackland Road); company posts also call Lackland a 'sister company'. Land and capital decisions sit with Tim Fleet; no head of land, CFO or controller is named publicly (a 2021 post mentions a Land Acquisition Coordinator role without a name). Published contacts: Riverside corporate (817) 451-6230, sales 817-734-8528, customerservice@rshomebuilders.com; Lackland land and partner inquiries 817-731-7595, webinfo@lacklandholdings.com. Legal entity name per public-record listings (Riverside Homebuilders Ltd, formed 2013-05-30).
profile.summary: Fort Worth family-owned builder, DFW only, about 650 closings and roughly $300M to $330M of revenue in 2025 (the company says 640+ closings and 'upwards of $330 million'; Builder lists 649 and $301M). Known for one-acre-plus homesites in exurban counties plus some smaller-lot neighbourhoods, about 25 communities listed. It is a conventional for-sale builder, but its land comes mainly from its own affiliate, Lackland Holdings, which says on its website that it is not interested in new financing sources and uses its own equity and bank loans; that makes it a low-probability land-banking customer, though Lackland does invite lot sellers and transaction partners to call.

people.note: Owner and top decision-maker for both land and capital: he also formed Lackland Holdings, LLC (1991), the affiliated developer that buys and develops land and sells lots to Riverside (lacklandholdings.com). No separate head of land or CFO is published, so land and financing conversations start with him. Builder's 2026 Builder 100 profile lists him as CEO; the company's own pages use president and founder. The phone shown is the Lackland Holdings office line, which that site publishes for land sellers and transaction partners (general mailbox webinfo@lacklandholdings.com).
